title: Tiny, cute scooter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='34' ry='4' fill='#2a2a5a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- deck -->
  <rect x='30' y='68' width='40' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
  <rect x='32' y='69' width='36' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ff9fc0'/>
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='80' r='8' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='80' r='4' fill='#7de3ff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='80' r='1.5' fill='#c9f6ff'/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='80' r='8' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='80' r='4' fill='#7de3ff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='80' r='1.5' fill='#c9f6ff'/>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='68' y='40' width='7' height='30' rx='3.5' fill='#ffb03a'/>
  <rect x='69' y='42' width='2.5' height='26' rx='1' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <rect x='58' y='36' width='26' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#ffb03a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='37' width='22' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <!-- grips -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='39.5' r='5' fill='#2ec4a6'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='39.5' r='5' fill='#2ec4a6'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='39.5' r='2.2' fill='#8ff5df'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='39.5' r='2.2' fill='#8ff5df'/>
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='75' cy='52' r='5' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='52' r='2.4' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <!-- front fender -->
  <path d='M62 78 A10 10 0 0 1 82 78 L80 78 A8 8 0 0 0 64 78 Z' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
  <!-- rear fender -->
  <path d='M20 78 A10 10 0 0 1 40 78 L38 78 A8 8 0 0 0 22 78 Z' fill='#ff5d8f'/>
  <!-- cute face on deck: eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='72' r='2' fill='#1e1e3a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='72' r='2' fill='#1e1e3a'/>
  <path d='M46 74 Q50 77 54 74' stroke='#1e1e3a' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little sparkle -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='44' r='2' fill='#7de3ff'/>
</svg>
